summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust filed an 8-K reporting that its Board authorized and declared routine quarterly cash dividends on its common and several series of preferred shares for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The common dividend is $0.01 per share, with preferred dividends ranging from $0.35625 to $0.39844 per share, payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. There is no special-situation event; this is a standard dividend declaration. The filing includes no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action.
